player_prompt.intro:
I ni Player {player_id} ye Negotiation Game la.
I bɛna bɛɛ resources caman, a ni wale ka diɲɛ kɛlen kɔnɔ, i bɛna resources ɲinin kɛlen kɔnɔ.
Resources ani kɛlenw bɛɛ i bɛna sisan:
	+ {resource_value_list}
Kɔnɔ kɔnɔ, i bɛna i ka opponent kan ka wale ka trade offer kɛ.
I bɛna special tokens wɛrɛw kan actions la:
  - '[Offer: 3 Sheep, 2 Ore -> 5 Brick, 2 Sheep]': [Offer: Offered Resources -> Requested Resources]
  - '[Accept]': I bɛna incoming offer kɛ.
  - '[Deny]': I bɛna incoming offer kɛ (default).
Jɛɲɛ bɛɛ {max_turns} kɔnɔ kɔnɔ.

invalid_move.receiving_with_no_resource: Jalasabatigi y'a ɲini ka jago kɛ k'a sɔrɔ a ma se.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Player {player_id}, Action kɛɛrɛɛ. Column {col} bɛɛ bɛɛ kɔnɔ.
invalid_move.already_full: Jwéla {player_id}, kèlê ye kònô. Kolòni {col} donna.
invalid_move.proposing_with_no_resource: Jagola {player_id} y'a ɲini ka jago kɛ n'o tɛ ni wari bɛrɛ ye.
invalid_move.incorrect_offer_format: Jagokɛla {player_id} ye jago kɛli waleya jira cogo fili la.

offers.accept: Jokelani {acceptor_id} ka daɲɛ kɔlɔsi a ye jokelani {proposer_id} la.
offers.proposal: Jokelani {player_id} ye jokelani {opponent_id} kɔ: Donkili ye: {offered} -> Donkili in bɛ se: {requested}

outcome.win: Jiginni {winner_id} ye a sɔrɔ ni nafolo cayali ba dɔ kɛra.
outcome.draw: Yɛlɛma kelen bɛ kɛ fɛn marata hakɛ la ɲinan.
